findings.failureScenario: Progress renders <progress max value /> with no accessible name (no aria-label/aria-labelledby/wrapping label); the visible text label is a sibling <span>, not associated. A screen reader user tabbing or browsing to the import/export/SAM download progress hears only an unnamed progress bar with a percentage and cannot tell which operation it reports.
findings.action: Give each <progress> an aria-label or aria-labelledby pointing at the adjacent label span (job label / 'Downloading SAM 3' / 'Verifying SAM 3 model folder').
